name: dev
description: Plan, build, verify and land code changes through one pipeline — /dev:fix, /dev:task, /dev:feature, /dev:build and /dev:deliver — with approval gates, sequential implementers, a subtractive prune pass and stacked PRs. On request, /dev:review posts inline PR findings that survived a refutation pass, and /dev:fix-pr-comments acts on the unresolved PR threads. Project-specific checks and git flow come from the project's own verify and git-workflow skills, which /dev:setup writes
